points: The same night the Lord sends Gideon down to the outside of the enemy host with Phurah his servant: thou shalt hear what they say, and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened. There he hears a man telling his fellow a dream of a cake of barley bread tumbling into the host and overturning a tent, and his fellow interprets it: this is nothing else save the sword of Gideon, for into his hand hath God delivered Midian.

note.label: Judges 7: The Three Hundred: The Victory Is the Lord's
